description: Adds the user's email (and optional ZIP code) to the Marian waitlist. Only call this when the user has explicitly asked to join, and pass user_consent: true to confirm that. Joining the waitlist isn't an application for credit.

user_consent.description: Must be true: confirms the user explicitly asked to join the waitlist with this email.

name: join_waitlist
title: Join the Marian waitlist
